name: DualEntry
title: A complete path from finance signal to a booked conversation
subtitle: Lifecycle engineering · Finance ICP · Outbound experiments
focus: Connect relevant finance-team research to HubSpot lifecycle, booking recovery and the buying committee behind an ERP decision.
priorities: Own HubSpot lifecycle, routing and lead handoffs.
Recover lead dropoff and incomplete booking journeys.
Build outbound workflows across Clay, Smartlead and HeyReach.
Test copy and measure the funnel through qualified outcomes.
layers: Public finance hiring, business complexity and verified stakeholder context.
Distinguish a plausible research signal from a confirmed ERP evaluation.
Track form, booking, owner and response events as separate lifecycle steps.
Join message variants, held demos and validation outcomes without duplicate credit.
rules: Finance hiring is not proof that an ERP replacement is underway.
Controller, CFO and IT responsibilities need verification for the actual buying process.
Use solution validation and implementation planning; do not invent a free trial.

personas.name: Controller / finance operations
personas.pain: Close, consolidation and reporting workflows that span systems
personas.promise: A concrete discussion of the finance process and its evaluation criteria.
personas.subject: A question about {{finance_workflow}}
personas.email: Hi {{first_name}}, the public context around {{business_change}} made me curious about your {{finance_workflow}} process. How does the team handle that today, and where does manual coordination show up?
personas.question: Which part of close, consolidation or reporting would be useful to validate?

personas.name: CFO / executive sponsor
personas.pain: A business decision that depends on implementation scope and confidence
personas.promise: A clear problem, decision criteria and realistic implementation dependencies.
personas.subject: The evaluation behind {{business_change}}
personas.email: Hi {{first_name}}, I’d start an ERP discussion with the business outcome and implementation requirements your team needs to preserve. Who should help define the finance and technical criteria for a focused evaluation?
personas.question: What would make a solution evaluation useful enough to enter implementation planning?

pitch: I hold a B.S. in Accounting and bring more than a decade of enterprise sales and partnership experience. I have also built a local CRM with pipeline stages and campaign drafts, along with inquiry and follow-up workflows. At DualEntry, I would pair finance literacy with hands-on building to improve account relevance, lifecycle ownership and the path from interest to a useful conversation.
mappings: B.S. Accounting, Eller College of Management.
Ask a useful question about the finance workflow and buying process.
Hire Line Dancers: matching, inquiries and dependable follow-up.
Connect the form, calendar, owner and actual response.
Startup messaging and outbound; local CRM with campaign drafts.
Test relevant copy and measure through held, qualified conversations.
northStar: Qualified finance conversations with a complete lifecycle
weekOne: An owned recovery workflow for one incomplete demo-booking path.
days60: Connect finance account intelligence to outbound variants and HubSpot lifecycle receipts; improve the buying map.
days90: Use held-demo and solution-validation outcomes to refine targeting, copy and implementation handoffs.

firstBuilds.scope: 20 accounts across two finance complexity segments.

firstBuilds.title: Lifecycle + copy measurement

projectRelevance.sammy: Structured records and source evidence support finance-account research without overstating replacement intent.
projectRelevance.sidequest: The partnership CRM’s pipeline stages and campaign drafts are relevant to HubSpot lifecycle thinking and outbound measurement.
projectRelevance.dancers: Private inquiries, approval-based billing and follow-up recovery are useful patterns for booking and implementation handoffs.
